subject: maths
question: Akash can finish a work in 18 days, while Navin can finish the same work in 36 days. If they work together to finish the work, find the portion of the work done by Navin.
solution:
**Given:**

Akash can finish a work in 18 days

Navin can finish the same work in 36 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by Akash in 1 day = 1/18

Work done by Navin in 1 day = 1/36

Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day = 1/18 + 1/36

Portion of work done by Navin = (Work done by Navin in 1 day) / (Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day)

**Calculation:**

Work done by Akash in 1 day = 1/18

Work done by Navin in 1 day = 1/36

Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day = 1/18 + 1/36

⇒ Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day = (2 + 1)/36

⇒ Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day = 3/36

⇒ Total work done by Akash and Navin in 1 day = 1/12

Portion of work done by Navin = (1/36) / (1/12)

⇒ Portion of work done by Navin = (1/36) × (12/1)

⇒ Portion of work done by Navin = 12/36

⇒ Portion of work done by Navin = 1/3

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
